lines.t: {{exploration_club_pres_kunigiku}}
The {{exploration_club}}, you see,

is a club for exploring every nook and
cranny of
Loose Geyser Island~.
{{mio}}

So you mean we walk all around
the island?
{{exploration_club_pres_kunigiku}}
Well, I guess so.
You all know by now that this island
used to be a Medalia mine, right?
They dug out all the {{medalia}}
and shut the mine down decades ago...

Before the mine and after it closed, until
the academy,

this island was uninhabited the whole
time.
Is that so...
{{exploration_club_pres_kunigiku}}

That's why there are old mining
facilities
left here and there on the island...
And on the other hand, there are blank

areas on the map that were never
recorded.

There's hardly any map of the back of
the mountain.
Perfect stage for an expedition, right~?
{{mio}}
So the club's activity is basically
just wandering around the whole island.
Hmph...
{{ryoma}}

Now, now, don't make such a bored
face.
...Look.
